extensions.description:
ClickHouse clusters powered by the Altinity Kubernetes Operator for
ClickHouse. Supports standalone and replicated topologies with a bundled
ClickHouse Keeper quorum.
extensions.name: altinity-clickhouse

extensions.description:
Apache Cassandra on Kubernetes, backed by the k8ssandra-operator.
Early-stage (pre-alpha): single-datacenter provisioning, scaling,
version upgrades, and on-demand and scheduled backup/restore via Medusa.
PITR, TLS and monitoring are not yet supported.
extensions.name: cassandra

extensions.description:
Highly available PostgreSQL clusters powered by the CloudNativePG
operator. Supports replica-set topologies with bootstrap, managed roles,
and PostgreSQL tuning.
extensions.name: cloudnative-pg

extensions.description:
A working "hello world" OpenEverest plugin: registers a sidebar entry,
a dedicated route, a cluster-detail tab, and a backend API endpoint.
Use it as a starting point when building your own generic plugin.
extensions.name: generic-plugin-template

extensions.description:
Serve machine-learning and LLM models on Kubernetes with KServe. Supports
generative LLM serving (vLLM) and predictive model serving, with GPU
scheduling, autoscaling, and a curated model catalog.

prerequisites.description: The KServe controllers run admission webhooks whose certificates cert-manager issues; its CRDs must be present. The chart bundles cert-manager by default — install with cert-manager.enabled=false when the cluster already provides it.
prerequisites.name: cert-manager

extensions.name: kserve

extensions.description:
MariaDB on Kubernetes, backed by the mariadb-operator. Runs standalone,
replication and Galera topologies with TLS, MaxScale, scheduled backups
with point-in-time recovery, scaling, version upgrades, custom my.cnf
configuration, and optional Prometheus monitoring.
extensions.name: mariadb

extensions.description:
Milvus vector database on Kubernetes, backed by the Milvus Operator.
Early-stage (pre-alpha): standalone and cluster topologies with bundled
or external etcd, object storage and Pulsar, scaling, version upgrades
and pod scheduling, backups via milvus-backup and Prometheus monitoring.
TLS and PITR are not yet supported.
extensions.name: milvus

extensions.description:
Send the databases of OpenEverest instances to Coroot. Installs the
`coroot` MonitoringClass and a controller that turns the provider's
connection endpoints into `coroot.com/*` pod annotations, so
coroot-cluster-agent discovers and connects to each database pod.

prerequisites.description: Coroot with coroot-cluster-agent, which connects to the annotated database pods. The agent is configured with the Coroot server and API key when it is installed.
prerequisites.name: Coroot

extensions.name: monitoring-coroot

extensions.description:
Send the metrics of OpenEverest database instances to any OTLP receiver
(Grafana Cloud, Datadog, Elastic, an OpenTelemetry Collector, or Prometheus
and VictoriaMetrics over OTLP). Installs the `opentelemetry` MonitoringClass
and a controller that runs an OpenTelemetry Collector per destination,
scraping the metrics endpoints the provider publishes.

prerequisites.description: Required by the OpenTelemetry Operator webhook and for mTLS between each collector and its Target Allocator.
prerequisites.name: cert-manager

prerequisites.description: Only the CRDs: the collectors' Target Allocators discover targets through the PodMonitors the controller renders. No Prometheus is needed.
prerequisites.name: Prometheus Operator CRDs

prerequisites.description: Runs the collector of each destination. Use a collector image with the prometheus receiver, the otlp and otlphttp exporters and the basicauth and bearertokenauth extensions, such as otel/opentelemetry-collector-k8s.
prerequisites.name: OpenTelemetry Operator

extensions.name: monitoring-otel

extensions.description:
Send metrics and Query Analytics of OpenEverest database instances to a
Percona Monitoring and Management (PMM) 3 server. Installs the `pmm`
MonitoringClass and its controller; providers with native PMM support
(Percona XtraDB Cluster, Percona Server for MongoDB, Percona PostgreSQL)
run pmm-client next to the databases.

prerequisites.description: The PMM server the database instances send their metrics and Query Analytics to. It must be reachable from the cluster.
prerequisites.name: PMM 3 server

extensions.name: monitoring-pmm

extensions.description:
Send the metrics of OpenEverest database instances to a Prometheus run by
the Prometheus Operator. Installs the `prometheus` MonitoringClass and a
controller that renders one PodMonitor per database component from the
metrics endpoints the provider publishes.

prerequisites.description: Renders the generated PodMonitors; a Prometheus must select them.
prerequisites.name: Prometheus Operator

extensions.name: monitoring-prometheus

extensions.description:
Send the metrics and query statistics of OpenEverest MySQL, MariaDB and
PostgreSQL instances to Releem for configuration and query recommendations.
Installs the `releem` MonitoringClass and a controller that runs one
releem-agent per database server, logging in with the read-only monitoring
user the provider publishes.

prerequisites.description: A Releem account and its API key, stored in the credentials Secret of the MonitoringDestination. Query analytics needs a paid plan.
prerequisites.name: Releem account

extensions.name: monitoring-releem

extensions.description:
Send the metrics of OpenEverest database instances to a VMAgent run by
the VictoriaMetrics Operator. Installs the `victoriametrics` MonitoringClass
and a controller that renders one VMPodScrape per database component from
the metrics endpoints the provider publishes.

prerequisites.description: Renders the generated VMPodScrapes; a VMAgent must select them.
prerequisites.name: VictoriaMetrics Operator

extensions.name: monitoring-victoriametrics

extensions.description:
Microsoft SQL Server on Kubernetes, provided by Solanica. Runs standalone
instances and Always On availability groups with automated backups,
point-in-time restore, TLS and Prometheus monitoring. Commercial, gated extension — contact Solanica for access.

gated.instructions: Commercial license required. Contact Solanica to request access, licensing, and private registry credentials.

extensions.name: mssql

extensions.description:
The Neo4j graph database on Kubernetes, backed by the Neo4j Kubernetes
Operator. Community standalone servers, and Enterprise clusters with
analytics and read pools, TLS by default, online backups to S3-compatible
storage, restores, and Prometheus metrics. Enterprise features need you
to accept the Neo4j Enterprise license.
extensions.name: neo4j

extensions.description:
OpenSearch clusters powered by the OpenSearch Kubernetes Operator.
Supports the standard topology, optional OpenSearch Dashboards, TLS
everywhere, and S3-compatible snapshot backups and restore.
extensions.name: opensearch

extensions.description: Production-ready PostgreSQL clusters powered by the Percona Operator for PostgreSQL.
extensions.name: percona-postgresql

extensions.description:
Production-ready MongoDB clusters powered by the Percona Operator.
Supports replica sets and sharded topologies.
extensions.name: percona-server-mongodb

extensions.description:
Highly available MySQL clusters powered by the Percona Operator for MySQL
based on Percona Server for MySQL, with async replication and MySQL
Group Replication topologies.
extensions.name: percona-server-mysql

extensions.description:
Highly available MySQL clusters powered by the Percona Operator for MySQL
based on Percona XtraDB Cluster (PXC).
extensions.name: percona-xtradb-cluster

extensions.description:
Captures every OpenEverest platform event and keeps a searchable audit log:
who did what, when, to which resource. Adds an Audit page with an events
chart over time, time ranges, filters by engine, kind, namespace, actor and
severity, free-text search, and CSV/JSON export. Events are stored in an
embedded SQLite database on a persistent volume.
extensions.name: plugin-audit

extensions.description:
Benchmark the performance of OpenEverest database clusters. Start a run
from the cluster detail page; each run executes in a temporary Kubernetes
Job and reports throughput and latency. PostgreSQL is supported today,
with more database engines planned.
extensions.name: plugin-bench

extensions.description:
Create instant, writable branches of OpenEverest databases for development,
testing, migration validation and AI-agent workflows. Branch, reset, restore
and promote database state without cloning production infrastructure.
Commercial, gated extension provided by Solanica.

gated.instructions: Commercial license required. Contact Solanica to request access, licensing, and private registry credentials.

extensions.name: plugin-branching

extensions.description:
Surfaces every plugin and provider published in the official OpenEverest
catalog and shows which ones are installed on your cluster. Searchable,
filterable table with install status, channel version, categories, and a
per-entry detail drawer with a copy-pasteable helm install command.
extensions.name: plugin-hub

extensions.description:
Adds an Inspector tab to database cluster detail pages. See the pods behind
an instance as a diagram or table, stream container logs, and describe a
pod with its containers, conditions and events. Works with any provider.
extensions.name: plugin-inspector

extensions.description:
Adds a Metrics tab to database cluster detail pages with CPU, memory and
engine-specific charts for the last hour or day, plus a search to chart any
other metric the instance exposes. Reads from Prometheus, PMM and other sources, scoped to
instances the user can read. Built-in dashboards for various database engines.
extensions.name: plugin-metrics

extensions.description:
Migrates databases into OpenEverest with minimal downtime: a per-migration
worker copies existing data (full load), keeps the target in sync with
ongoing changes (change data capture), and you trigger the cutover when
your application is ready to switch. The first engine moves MongoDB into
Percona Server for MongoDB instances using Percona ClusterSync for MongoDB.
extensions.name: plugin-migrations

extensions.description:
Adds a MongoDB Explorer tab to PSMDB cluster detail pages. Browse
databases and collections, run find queries with filter, projection,
limit, and sort, and view results as a table or raw JSON.
extensions.name: plugin-mongodb-explorer

extensions.description:
Adds a Users tab to database instance pages to create database users and
manage their roles, so teams stop sharing the admin account. Users are
InstanceUser resources reconciled into the database, with generated
credentials stored in a Secret applications can mount. For models on the
Envoy AI Gateway, the same users are per-application API keys.
extensions.name: plugin-user-management

extensions.description:
Distributed object storage with an S3-compatible gateway on Kubernetes,
backed by the seaweedfs-operator. Provisions master, volume, filer, and
S3 components. Early-stage (MVP): not for production use.
extensions.name: seaweedfs

extensions.description:
Distributed, MySQL-compatible NewSQL database with HTAP capabilities,
powered by TiDB Operator v2. Provisions a PD + TiKV + TiDB cluster.
extensions.name: tidb

extensions.description:
Valkey clusters powered by the Valkey Kubernetes Operator.
Supports replication and sharded cluster topologies. Very early stage.
extensions.name: valkey
